"score_team_1": 3,
"score_team_2": 0,
"team1_win_probability": 82,
"draw_probability": 12,
"team2_win_probability": 6,

"white_hat": "Argentina are reigning World Cup champions (2022) and ranked in the top 2 globally. Messi leads an exceptional squad with world-class talent throughout. Austria are a competitive European side but ranked significantly lower, around 25th-30th globally. Argentina's recent form has been dominant, winning Copa America 2024. Head-to-head historically favors Argentina heavily. Austria have solid UEFA Nations League performances but lack World Cup pedigree at this level.",

"red_hat": "Argentina carry the emotional momentum of defending champions with Messi likely in his final World Cup. The team plays with incredible passion and national pride. There is an aura of invincibility around this squad that intimidates opponents. Austria, while technically solid, may struggle psychologically against the weight of Argentine expectation and Messi's legendary presence. The crowd energy surrounding Argentina at major tournaments is electric and motivating.",

"black_hat": "Argentina's aging squad, particularly Messi, could face fitness concerns by tournament time in 2026. Austria's pressing style under their modern tactical setup could disrupt Argentina's build-up play. If Argentina suffer early complacency against a supposedly weaker opponent, Austria could nick a goal. Key Argentine players like Di Maria may have retired by 2026, weakening depth. Injuries and yellow card accumulations remain unpredictable wildcards.",

"yellow_hat": "Argentina possess unmatched individual quality with Messi, Alvarez, Martinez, and Mac Allister forming a formidable unit. Their tactical flexibility under Scaloni has proven world-beating. Defending champions carry confidence and experience in high-pressure knockout scenarios. Austria lack the defensive solidity to contain Argentina's creative attacking play for 90 minutes. Argentina's strength across all positions gives them multiple routes to victory.",

"green_hat": "An unconventional scenario: Austria could employ an ultra-defensive 5-4-1 low-block formation reminiscent of the 'bus parking' strategy, making it difficult for Argentina. Alternatively, if this is a group stage match, Argentina might rotate heavily, giving Austria a genuine chance. A surprise Austrian striker having a breakout tournament moment could change dynamics. Climate and venue conditions in North America in 2026 summer heat could affect both teams equally and unpredictably.",

"blue_hat": "Synthesizing all hats: The White Hat confirms Argentina's massive objective quality advantage. The Yellow Hat reinforces their strengths as defending champions. The Red Hat adds emotional and psychological dominance. The Black Hat raises legitimate concerns about aging, complacency, and Austrian tactical threats, but these are insufficiently large to override the quality gap. The Green Hat scenarios are possible but low probability. Combining these factors, Argentina win convincingly with approximately 82% probability, a draw at 12%, and Austrian win at 6%. A 3-0 scoreline reflects Argentina's dominance while acknowledging defensive solidity rarely produces clean shutouts without some resistance."
}
